source.title: Hush Money
source.description:
Let me tell you how this is gonna go. I can't afford you being around no more's so here's what we are gonna do. You are gonna leave right now. However in exchange for your generously timed excursion out of here, once a week you can come back.

When you do, you might swing by here and see a little somethin' somethin' on the ground that you might be so inclined to pick up. And I would be so grateful for this act of service I couldn't help but feel inclined to reward you in some way.
source.objective: Accept the bribe from Maximillian "The Greaser"
